versions.changelog:
- Initial release of aries-holiday-weekday skill.
- Supports querying Chinese holiday/workday status for specific dates or entire months based on official State Council (gov.cn) notices.
- Accurately distinguishes between statutory holidays, weekend make-up workdays, and regular weekdays.
- Automatically fetches and caches annual holiday arrangements from gov.cn if not already available.
- Returns results in a clear, structured format for both single-date and month-wide queries.
